name: Create HD Ticket From Export Certificate Application
script:
ticket = frappe.get_doc({
    "doctype": "HD Ticket",
    "subject": f"Export Certificate - {doc.name}",
    "description": f"""
Application Number: {doc.name}

Applicant: {doc.contact_person_email}

An Export Certificate Application has been submitted.
""",
    "priority": "High",
    "custom_export_certificate_application": doc.name
})

ticket.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

# Save ticket number back to application
frappe.db.set_value(
    "Export Certificate",
    doc.name,
    "helpdesk_ticket_link",
    ticket.name
)

name: Auto Create User from Web Form Lead
script:
# Only run this logic if the Lead originated from the public website registration form
if doc.flags.from_web_form or doc.lead_owner == "Guest":
    
    # Check if a user account already exists with this email address
    if not frappe.db.exists("User", doc.email_id):
        
        # Determine the user's first and last name from the Lead record
        first_name = doc.first_name or doc.lead_name or "Valued"
        last_name = doc.last_name or ""
        
        # Create the new User document
        user = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "User",
            "email": doc.email_id,
            "first_name": first_name,
            "last_name": last_name,
            "send_welcome_email": 1,  # Automatically emails them a link to set their password
            "user_type": "Website User",  # Restricts them to the public portal layout only
            "roles": [
                {
                    "role": "Customer"  # Grants standard Customer Portal visibility permissions
                }
            ]
        })
        
        # Insert the user into the database without running strict system validation flags
        user.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        
        # Optional: Link the newly created user profile directly back to the originating Lead
        doc.db_set("user", doc.email_id)
        
        # Log a record of the automation in the system error/activity log for troubleshooting
        frappe.log_error(
            title="Portal User Created Automatically",
            message=f"Portal User account successfully created for Lead: {doc.email_id}"
        )
